items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads A1 and dispensed into each of 96 wells followed by 10 aspirate/dispense mixes of 40 uL (e.g. lines 4-23 for A1); the 5 min incubation comment precedes the magnet comment.

Engage-magnet/wait comment recorded; 90 uL aspirated from each sample well to waste A1 (lines 2306-2688), then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added to all wells and 200 uL removed from all wells to waste.
Air dry 5 min and disengage comments recorded; 50 uL water added per well with 10 mixes (lines 4226-4247); 2 min incubation and re-engage comment follows before transfer.
Lines 6530-6911 aspirate 45 uL from each sample well and dispense into the same-named elution_plate well (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Every well in each step has its own pick up tip/drop tip pair (e.g. lines 2305-2308, 3073-3076, 6529-6532), so no tip touches more than one sample.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the simulator log on all steps: 40 uL beads with 10 mixes, 90 uL supernatant removal, two 200 uL ethanol washes removed, 50 uL water with 10 mixes, and 45 uL transfer to matching elution wells. A fresh tip is used per well throughout, and every non-pipetting step is recorded with protocol.comment at the right point.
